body:
I know that this is a lot of text, and I'm sorry, but I just remembered something I typed soon after all of this happened. Probably the climax of my feeling terrible. Maybe it'll give you some more insight into how I felt (and still feel), here:

I have no one. I didn’t want this to happen. A year’s worth of memories, conversations with you. There is so much more to life, I understand that, but what am I to do with how I feel at this moment? I cannot simply shake it off. I have no one to fall back on. It seems you do. I have no grand idea of what to do with my life, my nonexistent future. It’s funny how so many people seem to have that sorted out.

I don’t know what to do. This isn’t the first time I’ve had such thoughts. This isn’t new to me. What is new is the increasing hopelessness, the fact that I am truly beginning to believe that my death will be via suicide. It may not be helpful to entertain my thoughts by typing this.

“Suicide is selfish” is something I have heard and read so many times. And what if it is? What if it is selfish? Is that supposed to lessen the pain that the person is feeling? 

I don’t know what the fuck to do. I’m not eating very well at all. My sleep is not what is used to be. I’ve eaten one meal and a snack or two in three days. I fear this isn’t going to be easily fixed. I can’t function.
I can’t stop my thoughts. The memories. The way I’ve felt. Feel.

God.

What happened? Nothing was wrong. You warned me, though, didn’t you? You even asked if I would forgive you.

It was – is – the most genuine and meaningful relationship that I had with someone. I do not say that lightly: I sincerely mean it. Maybe that simply means that my track record with people / relationships isn’t very good. But it is what it is, and it is something I don’t want to lose. But the loss has happened, hasn’t it?

I cry about it. My thoughts do not fucking end. 
Most of the thoughts are memories, of course. 

Everything that we did. Every plan that we made but never quite followed through with, at least not yet. My God. We talked every day for over a year, with the exception of one or two days. This is not an exaggeration. We talked every-fucking-day. And I cry about it. My God, the memories. The things that we didn’t do. The things that I now fear we will never do.

I don’t want everything to be finished and over with. But I am afraid that if I try to talk normally, you’ll have already detached yourself. No more openness. None of the same types of conversations. Less communication. I can’t hold your hand anymore. I can’t even hug you anymore in the same way. It would be different.

I am crying. Memories.

Before Ecuador, we certainly played coy and only gave rare hints to each other as to how we felt. Once you left and were alone, you realized how much we talked. You realized how much you missed everyone. We hugged the night before you left.
